scripts.dev: docker-compose up -d --wait && bun run db:migrate && turbo dev
scripts.dev:web: docker-compose up -d --wait && bun run db:migrate && turbo dev --filter=@trst/web
scripts.dev:agent: docker-compose up -d --wait && bun run db:migrate && turbo dev --filter=@trst/agent
scripts.db:reset: docker-compose down -v && docker-compose up -d --wait && bun run db:migrate
